name: WEMIX Dollar
oneLiner: WEMIX Dollar is the WEMIX ecosystem's centralized dollar token, backed 100% by USDC held in the WEMIX3.0 Treasury on the non-EVM-indexed WEMIX chain.
collateral: 100% USDC backing held in the WEMIX3.0 Treasury; the DIOS stabilizer (Treasury-In/Treasury-Out protocols) maintains the 1:1 USDC peg.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption system using WEMIX$ Treasury USDC collateral and DIOS stabilization to keep WEMIX$ near one U.S. dollar.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: WEMIX Dollar primarily circulates on WEMIX chain, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: WEMIX$ discontinued
notices.message: WEMIX Foundation announced that WEMIX$ is being discontinued and ecosystem stablecoin activity is transitioning to USDC.e. Pharos keeps this record as legacy coverage until runtime sources fully remove it.

notices.title: 2026-07-26 exploit and eqWEMIX$ compensation
notices.message: On 2026-07-26 an unauthorized party took ownership of the retired DIOS and AMA contracts and minted 5,225,524.9997 WEMIX$ without authorization, draining 723,244.4936 USDC.e. WEMIX revoked minting authority and compensates losses in eqWEMIX$, exchangeable 1:1 for USDC.e via the WEMIX$ Module.

obituary.epitaph: The game-chain dollar stepped aside for bridged USDC
obituary.obituary: WEMIX transitioned its USD stablecoin activity from WEMIX$ to USDC.e, withdrawing Foundation liquidity from WEMIX$ pools and ending swap support across WEMIX.Fi and WEMIX PLAY in April 2026. Holders' WEMIX$ became eqWEMIX$, exchangeable 1:1 for USDC.e in the WEMIX$ Module; WEMIX$ can no longer be exchanged, and pool withdrawals run to 2027-03-05. Pharos freezes WEMIX$ as the retired native stablecoin while keeping its residual supply and history available in the archive.
